messages:
jordan: quick check — i'm about to land a terraform change that forces api_min_replicas = 3 for the api statefulset. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

jordan: also bumping container memory from 512Mi -> 1Gi to reduce oom churn we saw yesterday.

sasha: shouldn't break HPA if HPA.min_replicas <= 3. what's current HPA min?

kevin: HPA min is 1 today. fyi cluster-autoscaler will need extra headroom for the extra pods.

jordan: good point. i left a note in the PR to verify node pool capacity. terraform snippet:
```
module "api_statefulset" {
  source = "./modules/k8s-statefulset"
  name   = "api"
  replicas_min = var.api_min_replicas
  resources = {
    requests = { cpu = "250m", memory = "1Gi" }
    limits   = { cpu = "1",   memory = "1Gi" }
  }
}
```

devbot: terraform plan shows +2 instances for "module.api_statefulset.kubernetes_stateful_set.api[0]"

sasha: also check pod anti-affinity rules — if we force 3 replicas on a small cluster, affinity might prevent scheduling.

kevin: which nodepool is this pinned to? api runs on "gpu-general" or "cpu-standard"?

jordan: cpu-standard. current nodepool has 4 nodes with taints for infra. we have ~2 spare allocatable CPU per node.

ana: recs — either a) bump nodepool to 5 or b) relax anti-affinity for canary class pods. also consider a rollingUpdate.partition to avoid mass restarts.

mike: rollingUpdate.partition works for Deployment, but for StatefulSet we use podManagementPolicy and updateStrategy. suggest updateStrategy.type = "RollingUpdate" with partition unset (so full rolling update) and maxUnavailable = 1 equivalent via podManagementPolicy?

sasha: sample k8s overlay we use:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  podManagementPolicy: Parallel
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 0
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchLabels: { app: api }
              topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname"
```

jordan: if we relax required -> preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution it should schedule on dense clusters. i'll update PR with that option.

opsbot: FYI capacity-guard: cluster-autoscaler will cap to max nodes 6 unless you update nodepool autoscaling settings.

kevin: we should also add a TF var for nodepool_max so teams can bump during rollout without manual console changes.

ana: agree. add var nodepool_desired and nodepool_max in the same PR or a follow-up? prefer same PR to keep rollout atomic.

devbot: plan output after proposed change:
+ module.api_statefulset.replicas: 1 -> 3
+ module.nodepool_desired.size: 4 -> 5

jordan: i'll add nodepool bump and change anti-affinity to preferred. i'll also add a quick smokecheck job in the CI to hit /health across all pods after rollout.

mike: small nit — update the console alert threshold for pod OOM rate so we don't get noisy alerts during the resize.

sasha: sounds good. @jordan ping me when PR is ready and i'll do the final review. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — will send update in ~30m with plan output and the k8s overlay change.
